{{recipe}}
{{XWarning|Killing dogs may infringe religious dictates or even be illegal in some jurisdictions, especially if done outside of a supervision center that can perform the killing humanely and attest for the meat quality and sanitation (dogs can transmit rabies).}}

'''Anjing panggang''' is a specialty dish of grilled dog from Eastern Indonesia, the Southern Philippines, and other countries.

== Ingredients ==

=== Meat ===
* 1 small or medium-sized [[cookbook:dog|dog]], humanely slaughtered, skinned, and cleaned

=== Marinade ===
* 1 cup [[cookbook:vinegar|vinegar]]
* 3 tbsp [[cookbook:salt|salt]]
* 6 cloves [[cookbook:garlic|garlic]], crushed
* 20 spicy [[cookbook:Chili Pepper|Thai pepper]]s
* 3 [[cookbook:tomato|tomato]]es, puréed
* 3 cups [[cookbook:lemon|lemon]] juice

== Procedure == 
# Cut dog up into about 12–16 large pieces.
# In a [[Cookbook:Food Processor|food processor]], blend together all the marinade ingredients.
# Combine the dog pieces and marinade in a large container. Let [[Cookbook:Marinating|marinate]] for at least 2 hours in the fridge.
# Put dog pieces on a charcoal [[Cookbook:Grill|grill]], cover, and let it cook over warm coals. Flip and baste occasionally for about 1 hour or until meat is tender.
